specification: Same original fixed features and HGB hyperparameters; replace absolute_error with squared_error for all three component estimators; nonnegative components; PRA exact sum. No retuning or further candidate trials.
rationale: Conditional means add coherently for aggregate expectation, unlike component medians. MAE gain is not guaranteed.
gate: Date-cluster bootstrap upper 99.375% two-sided interval (quantile .996875) of validation MAE difference below zero, diagnostic MAE delta <=0. This uses Bonferroni family8 for two candidates times four originally inspected markets. Also report ordinary95% and family2 PRA97.5% intervals. 10000 bootstrap repetitions, seed20261112.
limits: Seasons reused after previous results; exploratory, no pristine confirmation set, no prospective or betting calibration claim. Historical source not independently crosschecked. Never primary eligible or auto deployed.
